scope: TASK-001 through TASK-016 plus TASK-033 maintenance acceptance subset; the supplied PRD remains the broader proposed catalog

requirements.text: Preserve publisher-scoped document identity separately from editions and packages.
Resolve identifiers conservatively and report ambiguity.
Pin evidence retrieval to an immutable installed edition package.
Preserve source bytes and validate their declared hashes.
Return exact evidence with required governing context.
Track required dependency context across retrieval and edition comparison.
Use portable data-only packs with explicit inventories.
Validate pack contracts strictly and reject unknown semantic fields.
Expose consistent structured read operations.
Do not split an atomic evidence unit to satisfy an output budget.
Traverse a declared obligation scope with stable pagination and coverage accounting.
Keep retrieval and derivation uncertainty explicit rather than converting it to approval.
Compare editions conservatively and surface dependency-context impacts.
Separate source rights claims from operational authorization.
Reauthorize every query against the installed digest grant.
Operate locally without network fallback or telemetry.
Keep administrative import separate from read-only queries.
Bind continuations to immutable snapshots, principals, and current policy state.
Treat indexes as rebuildable projections rather than evidence authority.
Expose detailed completeness dimensions and budget coverage.
Preserve stable official catalog metadata and verify locally acquired source bytes offline without embedding download behavior in query paths.
Compile verified PDFs deterministically while preserving raw source bytes separately from hashed extracted-text representations.
Expose text-layer, OCR, visual, table, figure, clause-boundary, and obligation-classification fidelity separately without inferring success.

Propagate declared pack coverage through search and retrieval, report source interpretation, dependency identification and retrieval, database traversal, and response fit separately, and provide a deterministic evidence-fetch path for every supported search result kind.

Represent reviewed document structure with stable edition-scoped logical identities, closed node kinds, typed relationships, and explicit unsupported regions, keeping content hashes and physical locations separate.
Bind structural nodes and relationship derivations to exact source spans over verified original bytes and hashed extracted page text, while keeping agent review and human approval distinct.

Offer an opt-in compact progressively expandable response profile with deterministic packet-local evidence, source, and derivation references; deduplicate source and derivation metadata without changing exact evidence text, canonical record IDs, completeness, authorization, or the default detailed JSON response.

Batch required-evidence retrieval and request-local source verification; use bounded versioned caches whose keys include content, traversal, corpus, ranking, and authorization visibility state; reauthorize and reverify integrity before return; and support explicit package- and clause-scoped lexical discovery without hidden fallback.

Verify every returned node and relationship evidence span against request-local immutable bytes; reuse verified bytes and decoded UTF-8 text within one request; batch obligation evidence assembly and edition-diff verification; and keep search filters, request echo, and exact evidence selectors replayable and truthful.

Reject inconsistent required-edge projections; bind compiled page evidence to exact byte spans; expose query limits without silently discarding constraints; and provide a measured concise evidence projection that retains exact text, citations, governing relationships, coverage, authorization, and expandable provenance.

Provide authorization-safe, stable paginated discovery of installed document packages with exact identity, representation, immutable package pins, record counts, declared coverage, and bounded replayable near-match hints without fuzzy, network, model, or authorization fallback.
